games.name: [NINJA ACADEMY] SHINSEI
games.desc:
🍃 Shinsei Ninja Academy 🍃

Train. Improve. Prepare.

Shinsei Ninja Academy was created to help players learn and practice the Hand Seal system before the official release of Shinsei. Improve your speed, memorize seal combinations, and prepare yourself for the battles that await in the full game.

🎁 AFK Rewards
Every 2 hours and 30 minutes, you'll receive a random reward:

Ryo (In-Game Currency)
Clan Spins
Appearance Spins

All rewards earned in Shinsei Ninja Academy will be transferred to your account when the main game releases.

💙 Support the Development 💙
Simply playing helps support the development of Shinsei through playtime. For those who would like to support the project even further, optional donation products are also available within the experience.

Whether you're here to train, AFK for rewards, or support the game, every visit helps us move one step closer to release.

Thank you for supporting Shinsei. We can't wait to see you when the full game release!
